items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: Remember the time you went out to play with Kid Thomas and all they had was a soft read on Edmund and the Washington's. ... But it still sounded wonderful to all of us in the band.

ctx.x: Can I ask one of the questions that I just thought of? This is the last one. This goes back quite a ways. I guess I wouldn't hardly get born yet, but I wondered, I've heard Thomas play and his style seems to, yeah, kid Thomas play and his style seems to not to go too high and not to hit too many notes. And I wondered if that would be a good style for a firenip to play with. What you mean Thomas Valentine? Yeah, Thomas. What, the trumpet player? No, if it's easier for him to play firenip with him, you mean. Yeah.…
Yeah, I imagine it's all right. I started with Thomas because Thomas is still playing the same way. Yeah, I know you played. Yeah.
